title: Ivanti Neurons for MDM, formerly MobileIron Cloud (Customer Integration API, GET only, Device Read Only admin)
readScopes: A dedicated Ivanti Neurons for MDM admin user (Users > Users) holding only the space-specific "Device Read Only" role for the device space read, whose user name and password go in IVANTI_MDM_USERNAME and IVANTI_MDM_PASSWORD; the tenant's admin portal address is IVANTI_MDM_URL. Calls: GET /api/v1/metadata/tenant, GET /api/v1/device and GET /api/v1/device/{id}. The API takes HTTP Basic authentication, which does not work when the admin portal requires a password and PIN.

checks.title: Each active device is compliant with its Ivanti policies
checks.scope: Every active device in the device space, one result per device, from complianceState in the device search. A device is only as compliant as the policies assigned to it.

checks.title: Each Mac has FileVault on, and each device reporting BitLocker is fully encrypted
checks.scope: Macs (platformType OSX) from osxFdeEnabled in Get Device Details; other devices from bitLockerEncryptionStatus where they report one (FULLY_ENCRYPTED passes, NOT_ENCRYPTED and PARTIALLY_ENCRYPTED fail, UNKNOWN is skipped). iOS and Android devices expose no encryption field and are not judged.

checks.title: Each active device runs an OS at or above the given minimum for its platform
checks.scope: Every active device, from platformVersion against --ivanti-mdm-min-os keyed by platformType (osx or macos, ios, android); without that option the check is skipped once. Vendor support dates are not looked up.

checks.title: Each active device has checked in within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every active device, from lastCheckin ("Last client checkin"); the window is --ivanti-mdm-checkin-days.

checks.title: Each iOS and Android device's passcode meets its Ivanti profiles
checks.scope: iOS and Android devices, from passcodeCompliantWithProfiles, else passcodeCompliant (iOS). It shows the passcode meets what the profiles demand, not the idle time before lock.

checks.title: The macOS application firewall is on
checks.scope: Macs, from osxFirewallSettings.firewallEnabled in Get Device Details; skipped once when the space has no Mac.

checks.title: System Integrity Protection is enabled on each Mac
checks.scope: Macs, from osxSystemIntegrityProtectionEnabled in Get Device Details; skipped once when the space has no Mac.
